title: Hubble Space Telescope is launched
summary: Space Shuttle Discovery lifted off on mission STS-31 carrying the Hubble Space Telescope, which it released into orbit the next day.
reason: Astronomers wanted a large telescope above the atmosphere, which blurs and absorbs starlight.
significance: Hubble transformed astronomy, from the age of the universe to the study of distant galaxies.
place: Kennedy Space Center, Florida, United States
